title: Clear out dissectors attempts to import old prefs into UATs
description:
Due to lack of well defined infrastructure to import individual
preferences into UATs some dissectors made attempts to do this using
dissector initialization functions.
This method proves fragile, possibly creating an inconsistent user
experience, and no guarantee the preference is actually imported.

The dissectors involved (TLS/DTLS) and their preferences (keys_list)
themselves are already very old (before the 2.0 era). Therefore
obsoleting these preferences permanently should have limited impact.
They may still have a use on the command line. These uses should
already have been updated to using present day preferences.

The radius dissector contains remnants of code which was part of such
preference import implementation, but this importing was already
replaced about 10 years ago (2eb7b05b8c9). Here we remove this code.
